_readme: focus-random-menu.mjs on Obsidian 1.15.1 (installer build 1.13.7), 2026-11-16, private headless sway, USER_DATA_DIR, CDP port 9474. One key per run, each holding the steps it is authoritative for: run3 = s01 editor:focus and s03 random-note (clean reset); run4 = s01 again with otherGroupCanvasThenType (where the next key goes); run5 = s02 context-menu edges and the real right clicks; run8 = s05 Highlight submenu; run9 = s07 checks; run10 = s04 submenus and s06 the commands run by id (rows run last-first: Insert > Table leaves the session unable to run the next editor command, and Format effects at a caret did not run because the first submenu open of a session missed). An earlier s04 (results7, Format rows over a selection) agreed with run10 and is not kept.
